plugins.name: mission
plugins.description: /mission opens a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, plus a code map of the files they touch. /mission:browser opens the code map in a live-refreshing browser tab.

plugins.name: plan-control
plugins.description: /plan-control opens a live map of Obeya tickets and local plans: dependencies, the interfaces each provides and consumes, mismatches, pull requests. One map per session.
